title: OKX Debuts "X Layer" Powered by Chainlink Scale and CCIP | OKX at SmartCon 2025
description:
At SmartCon 2025, Jason Lau, Chief Innovation Officer at @TheOKXGlobal , introduced X Layer, an EVM-compatible layer 2 that recently joined the Chainlink Scale program and integrated CCIP for secure cross-chain interoperability.

View the SmartCon 2025 playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVP9aGDn-X0R1kuQo8qLPnqlT7ThKQR2s&si=ieYBg4xfmhJ8gOA8

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: My name is Jason Lau. I'm Chief Innovation Officer at OKx. I know I'm between you and lunch. So I promise I will make this as interesting as I can and make it worthwhile for you. So today here, I'm here to talk about X-Layer. X-Layer is OKx's layer two. It's an EVM-compatible chain, highly performant, scalable, really designed for secure, high-throughput on-chain use cases. And we're just getting started. I want to talk a little bit about why we're building X-Layer, what we plan to do with it, and our approach to building our own network. I think first and foremost, at OKEx, we think about the user experience at its core. And so when we came to build out Xlayer and work with partners and build out the ecosystem, a lot of it was focused on how do we make sure that this is deeply integrated with the existing products that we have. At OKEx, if you don't know, we have 100 million users around the world today. Institutional users, retail users, obviously, and they come to us for a wide variety of products. Our exchange products for trading, they use our wallets for self-custodial and DeFi activities. People come use us for our DEX aggregator for cross-chain swaps and on-chain swapping. So there's a lot of places where we think X-Layer has value to add and really serve as a foundational layer for what we're building now and into the future. So I'm going to give you guys a little bit of a preview on where we're taking this. First and foremost, I mentioned trading. OKEx, we have a DEX, we also have on-chain trading. We're looking to eventually merge a lot of these experiences. On-chain liquidity, centralized exchange liquidity, put that all onto and use X Layer as that core foundational layer to enable all of that. We're thinking about payments also. In Singapore at Token 2049 just last month, we announced OKXPAY going live in Singapore, partnering with Grab, which is a local kind of merchant payment processor. And now users in Singapore and OKEx, they can use OKEx Pay to pay with stablecoins any merchant that accepts Grab Pay basically across the country. And that's powered on OKEx Pay and using X Layer as that foundational layer. And there's more to come. There's actually announcements that will happen later this week around OKX Pay globally that will again ride on this foundational layer of xLayer. On the wallet side too, xLayer is going to be a core piece of how users can earn and get rewarded for their assets in self-custody. So for example, today, if you hold USDG on X layer within the OKEx wallet, again, this is self-custody assets that you hold the keys to. You get to receive rewards on top of that. And again, this is powered on X layer, running on X layer, and this is just really Xlayer, running on Xlayer, and this is really the start of what we're building out within the wallet. And of course, none of this can be done without our partners, our friends, and, you know, you guys here, too. So, yesterday, we announced our joining the Chainlink scale program. Chainlink is live on X-Layer, providing developers and builders Oracle pricing, Oracle data across. We've also announced our use of CCIP as one of the bridges that allow for interoperability between X-Layer and other chains. Really excited to see how this will enable more use cases and more protocols to come on board. We've got more to come with the Chainlink team, so again, stay tuned for that. And then lastly, a sneak peek into what's happening soon. We are also, actually I think we've already announced this, launching an ecosystem fund that will allow for us to provide financial and also venture-type support for builders and projects and protocols that are deploying on to XLR. We'd love to invite you to participate in that. We've been talking to a lot of issuers, RWA issuers, and businesses that are looking to build on top of X-Layer. So again, we invite you to come reach out to us and talk about that with us. Next, in two weeks, we're actually going to be in Buenos Aires also at DevConnect hosting an event. And so again, we'd love to invite you guys to come connect with us and see how if you want to tap into the OKEx ecosystem, the community, the worldwide 100 million community that we're hoping to bring on chain via X-Layer, we'd love to work with you and build together with you. My colleague Shen is here. He's driving our efforts on the X-Layer front, leading a lot of our partnerships. If you see him around, feel free to grab him to. We're happy to talk. And with that, yeah, that's OKX Layer. That's X-Layer and that's why we're here at OKX Building. Thank you so much.
